integrity: The classification and counting are supported by an explicit algebraic proof and finite independent consistency checks. Earlier publications establish the motivating algebraic family and homological properties, not the asserted exact endomorphism monoid count. Publication and independent validation are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classification holds for unital K-algebra endomorphisms of oriented-cycle path algebras modulo the square of the arrow ideal; does not classify nonunital/semilinear maps, longer Loewy lengths, or module endomorphisms. Complete rank polynomial uses an \(n^n\) finite sum; total count has a closed form. Small-field enumerations corroborate the proof but are not a substitute for general reasoning. Bibliographic completeness under unrelated nomenclature is not established.
title: The endomorphism rank spectrum of radical-square-zero cyclic Nakayama algebras
